memos.skeptic: Most likely loss: a late-entry top after a parabolic run. The coin is up 152% over 30 minutes and 61% in the last 15, yet it's only 0.9% off its 30-minute high, so buying now means chasing momentum that has already attracted 241 buyers. Sellers are heavy: 142 sellers against 46.99 SOL sold versus 79.12 SOL bought, and net flow of +32 SOL can reverse fast once early holders take profit. Launch-bot presence and a top-5 buyer share of 43% suggest concentrated early supply that could distribute into this crowd. Graduation timing is unknown and there is no name, symbol, or metadata, so no independent check exists. At a $20 ticket with 1.4-5.1% round-trip costs and a 145 SOL pool, a normal pullback eats the margin. Skip.
